'''Magda Ulbreck''' was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Wyle Ulbreck]]. Shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], they were living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where Wyle was a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]].
